name: Aydem Yenilenebilir Enerji A.S.
summary: Aydem Yenilenebilir Enerji A.S. engages in renewable energy generation in Turkey. The company operates 20 hydroelectric, 3 wind, 1 hybrid solar and 1 geothermal power plants with a total installed capacity of 1,198 megawatts. It produces electricity using solar resources. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Merkezefendi, Turkey. Aydem Yenilenebilir Enerji A.S. is a subsidiary of Aydem Enerji Yatirimlari Anonim Sirketi.
